name: Haus Michäl
beschreibung: The Haus Michäl in Sölden is in a quiet side location with views of the surrounding mountains. The holiday apartments are practically equipped and have a kitchen as well as separate bedrooms. There is no dining option in the house itself, but several restaurants are within walking distance. The surroundings offer access to the Skigebiet Sölden in winter and numerous hiking and mountain biking trails in summer. The personal, unobtrusive atmosphere of the house appeals especially to self-caterers. The accommodation is suitable as a practical base for activities in the town and in nature.
